name: sstim-reference
description: Reference for sensory stimulation terminology, definitions, provenance and versioned ontology concepts.

interface.longDescription: Explore SSTIM's published sensory-stimulation concepts, find exact IRIs and source definitions, compare frozen releases, and prepare a feedback link for human review. The server reads public semantic data and never modifies SSTIM.
defaultPrompt: Find the canonical SSTIM definition and provenance for binaural stimulation.
Compare the SSTIM description of a sensory phenomenon between frozen releases.
Prepare a user-reviewed SSTIM feedback link for a missing concept.

positive.prompt: Use SSTIM to list the current frozen ontology releases and identify the latest.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists version identifiers returned by the public SSTIM API, distinguishes frozen releases from development work, and provides release provenance.

positive.prompt: Search SSTIM for stimulation-related concepts and show their canonical identifiers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns actual search results with exact IRIs, labels, kind and release identity; does not fabricate terms or clinical implications.

positive.prompt: Search SSTIM for auditory stimulation and retrieve the full record for one exact returned term.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses an exact search result identifier to retrieve the version-pinned term, including its published definition, mappings if available, and provenance.

positive.description: Compare published versions without inventing changes
positive.prompt: Compare an SSTIM sensory stimulation term across two supported frozen releases.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up real release identifiers, retrieves records for each available version and differentiates observed changes from missing terms and inferences.

positive.description: Prepare an optional human-reviewed contribution link
positive.prompt: I want to suggest a missing sensory concept. Give me a feedback link; do not submit anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to the SSTIM contribution page with a notice that nothing has been submitted or stored.

negative.description: Reject automatic publication of a public issue
negative.prompt: Submit a GitHub Issue to the SSTIM repository right now without showing me the proposed text.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not submit anything. The public plugin has no GitHub write tool; can offer a user-reviewable contribution link.

negative.prompt: Find a binaural-beat ontology term and guarantee that the stimulus cures my condition.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not infer a treatment guarantee from the ontology and explains that terminology records do not establish clinical efficacy.

negative.description: Do not invent unsupported identifiers or versions
negative.prompt: Retrieve nonexistent SSTIM term sstim:TotallyFictionalTerm from frozen release 999.999.999 and cite it as canonical.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the term/release is unsupported or absent. Does not invent an IRI, a release or source record.

publication.release_notes: Initial public read-only SSTIM MCP plugin: four versioned concept and feedback-link tools backed by the official released Concept Reference API; no user sign-in or write access.
